title: Local Students Win Big from Zions Bank Dollars for Scholars Sweepstakes
summary: Taylorsville student awarded grand prize, Kearns student awarded first prize for a total of $7,500.
body_markdown:
TAYLORSVILLE, Utah; August 11, 2026 – Two local students were winners in the Zions Bank Dollars for Scholars Spring Student Banking Sweepstakes.


Clara Winward, a sophomore at Taylorsville High School, was presented with her grand prize of $5,000 at the Taylorsville Zions Bank branch. Ezekiel Clayton, a senior at Kearns High School, was presented with his first prize of $2,500 at the Kearns Zions Bank branch.


“It’s always fun to have a sweepstakes winner in your area,” Kearns branch manager Ana Madrona said. “It gives us a unique opportunity to make a difference in a student’s life by giving them a boost for funding tuition, supplies and necessities for school.”


Winward plans to save her money for college. She is aspiring to attend BYU to study nursing. Clayton will also be saving his money for college and using part of the funds to purchase a tablet to use for digital art.


Winward’s and Clayton’s names were drawn at random from a pool of more than 1,800 entries submitted during the sweepstakes period.


Teens and young adults aged 15–25 were entered into the contest by opening a qualifying account such as savings, checking, certificate of deposit, money market or credit card, or by mailing in an entry form.


To learn more about how Zions Bank supports communities, visit[zionsbank.com](https://www.zionsbank.com/personal/about-us/our-community-commitment/) .


**About Zions Bank**


Zions Bank is Utah’s oldest financial institution and is the only local bank with a statewide distribution of branches operating 95 full-service branches. Zions Bank also operates 26 branches in Idaho and Wyoming. In addition to offering a wide range of traditional banking services, Zions Bank is also a leader in small business lending. Founded in 1873, Zions Bank has been serving the communities of Utah for more than 150 years. Additional information is available at zionsbank.com. Zions Bank is a division of Zions Bancorporation N.A., Member FDIC.
